[h1]游戏评测：《木筏求生 (Raft)》[/h1]
[h3]综合评分：8.5 / 10（蔚蓝汪洋中白手起家的漂流史诗）[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]画风与感官氛围 (8.8/10)[/b]：清爽的明快卡通视听，将海洋的孤独寂寥与碧海蓝天的度假感奇妙融合。
[*] [b]资源收集与循环 (8.5/10)[/b]：极具魔性的“勾垃圾”核心反馈，从单人前期手忙脚乱过渡到多人的快乐拆迁。
[*] [b]建筑自由与深度 (9.0/10)[/b]：强大的网格建造系统，支持玩家在漂流地基上生生手搓出一座移动的海上赛博堡垒。
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]中文评测[/h2]
在度过了无数个被鲨鱼咬碎地基、满海面拿钩子打捞塑料和木板的漂流夜晚后，我认为由 Redbeet Interactive 打造的《Raft》在百家争鸣的沙盒生存领域中，写下了一段独一无二的“空间限制”求生奇迹。它不同于传统生存游戏对无垠陆地的圈地征服，而是将玩家的命运死死绑定在了一座不断移动的生存母舰上。
[hr][/hr]
[h2]五大核心维度深度整合评测 (中文版)[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]1. 糖衣包裹的硬核危机（画面风格的奇妙反差）：[/b]
游戏的视觉采用了非常清爽、明快的卡通渲染风格。碧海蓝天、椰林树影，初看极具惬意的海岛度假感。但在这层无害的外表下，游戏塞满了各种极具压迫感的生存指标：高频消耗的饱食度与口渴值强迫你每天必须准时捕鱼、蒸馏海水，海鸥会偷吃作物，而海面下泛着寒光的鲨鱼则随时准备对你张开血盆大口。这种“画风越萌，死得越快”的反差感让生存前期充满了策略张度。
[*] [b]2. 从“黄金矿工”到自动化的魔性循环（核心收集机制）：[/b]
游戏最绝的设计，就是让玩家在一块 2x2 的木板上靠一把塑料钩子白手起家。扔出钩子、精准拖回飘来的塑料、木板、树叶和木桶，这种高度成瘾的交互逻辑极似3D版的“黄金矿工”。而随着科技树的解锁，当你终于能成排地铺满“自动收集网”，躺在躺椅上看着垃圾自己源源不断入库时，那种打破前期瓶颈、实现“垃圾收割自由”的爽感让人欲罢不能。
[*] [b]3. 违背地心引力的漂流奇迹（网格建筑深度）：[/b]
游戏基于网格坐标的建造系统赋予了极高维度的发挥空间。你的地基只是一座木筏，但你却可以通过立柱、楼梯和天花板，在公海上盖出一座几十层高的海上摩天大楼、航空母舰甚至是赛博朋克风的水上城堡。中后期加入的发动机、方向舵和锚固系统，更是能让你带着这座移动的“重工业奇迹”自由逆风航行，将“家”的移动城堡属性推向了极致。
[*] [b]4. 逼真的人工环境熵增压力（大白鲨 Bruce 的生态威慑）：[/b]
大白鲨（玩家戏称为 Bruce）是整款游戏关卡设计的神来之笔。它不仅会在你试图下海开采泥土、铁矿等核心资源时疯狂追杀你，更会定期浮出水面去啃咬、毁灭你的木筏地基。它是不可能被永久消灭的（杀死后几分钟内会重新刷新），这种永恒的、合理的自然威胁为游戏注入了高明的“熵增”压力，逼着你必须做出防御枪、不断用加固铁甲去强化每一块边缘地板。
[*] [b]5. 非线性“水下考古”叙事（剧情探索体验）：[/b]
与常规求生游戏的漫无目的不同，本作有着一条设计非常精妙的明线剧本。通过搭建雷达接收器与三根天线，在绿色的屏幕上定位一个又一个独特的剧情坐标。从荒废的海上高塔、被淹没的废土都市到盘踞着变异生物的科研海岛，每一个故事目的地都是完全独立的箱庭关卡。通过散落在各个角落的日记纸条、邮件，像侦探一样拼凑出人类世界被洪水淹没的后末日真相，剧情代入感极佳。
[/list]
[b]总结[/b]：总而言之，《木筏求生》用极低门槛的魔性操作，包裹住了一个宏大且极具纵深的海上重工业建造梦。无论你是想和好朋友来一场互相折磨、手忙脚乱的爆笑航海，还是渴望独自一人靠一把钩子撬动整座赛博海洋堡垒，它都是绝对不容错过的行业标杆级神作！
[hr][/hr]
[h2]English Review[/h2]
Raft by Redbeet Interactive is a triumphant, defining masterclass within the open-world survival genre, beautifully constructing an empire out of pure oceanic isolation. Shifting away from massive terrestrial landmasses, it forces players to tie their biological and creative survival entirely to an evolving, customizable floating home. Armed with nothing but a basic plastic hook to dredge drifting debris, you slowly climb a steep, industrializing tech tree while constantly warding off a relentless, ever-present shark threat. It masterfully fuses a bright, colorful cartoon aesthetic with intense mechanical stakes and non-linear, post-apocalyptic narrative ruins. It is an incredible, immensely addictive journey that treats the classic "zero-to-hero" crafting loop with absolute mechanical respect.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]5 Core Dimensions Integrated Review (English Version)[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]1. Hardcore Crises in Candy Wrapping (Visual Style Contrast):[/b]
The visual presentation utilizes a clean, vibrant cartoon-rendered aesthetic. The azure sky and tropical island silhouettes initially evoke a relaxing resort holiday vibes. However, beneath this harmless veneer lies an oppressive array of survival metrics: rapidly depleting hunger and thirst bars force you to fish and distill water constantly, seagulls pillage your crops, and a razor-fanged shark relentlessly patrols the perimeter. This sharp contrast between a cute art style and deadly stakes creates immense tactical tension early on.
[*] [b]2. From "Gold Miner" to Mechanical Automation (Core Collection Loop):[/b]
The game’s absolute hook is forcing players to survive on a tiny 2x2 wooden grid armed with nothing but a plastic hook. Throwing the hook and pulling in drifting plastic, wood, leaves, and barrels creates a deeply addictive mechanical loop. As the tech tree advances, placing a grid of "collection nets" allows you to lounge around while junk automatically streams into your inventory, transforming an exhausting grind into a satisfying harvest.
[*] [b]3. Architectural Miracles Defying Gravity (Grid-Based Construction):[/b]
The coordinate-based grid system unlocks boundless spatial freedom. Though your foundation is a mere raft, you can leverage pillars, stairs, and ceilings to construct multi-story skyscrapers, aircraft carriers, or cyberpunk-inspired floating fortresses on the high seas. The inclusion of late-game engines, steering wheels, and anchor systems turns this mobile industrial anomaly into a true wanderer, pushing the concept of a "home on the move" to its absolute peak.
[*] [b]4. Organic Environmental Stress (The Ecological Threat of Bruce):[/b]
The great white shark (lovingly dubbed "Bruce" by the community) is a structural masterstroke in level design. It doesn't just hunt you down when diving for rare iron or clay; it periodically surfaces to violently tear chunks out of your raft's foundation. It cannot be permanently eradicated, as a new threat spawns shortly after its death. This persistent environmental hazard injects an ingenious layer of stress, forcing you to craft metal armor plates and reinforce your home's borders.
[*] [b]5. Non-Linear Oceanic Archaeology (Story Exploration & Lore):[/b]
Departing from standard, aimless sandboxes, Raft features a beautifully paced linear narrative thread. By crafting a radar receiver and three antennas, you track glowing coordinate pings across a vast green display. From abandoned high-rise marine towers and submerged dystopian megacities to heavily guarded research eco-domes, each destination is an independent sandbox level. Piece-by-piece, players scour diaries and old emails to solve the post-apocalyptic riddle of a drowned world.
[b]Conclusion[/b]: Overall, Raft transcends the typical survival sandbox to deliver a profoundly structured, tactical experience built entirely on spatial adaptation. With its highly addictive core harvesting loop, intricate engineering progression, and beautifully layered box-set narrative encounters, it offers unparalleled late-night replayability. It stands as a flawless monument of creative survival that completely honors its mechanics and player agency.
[/list]

很有创意的海上生存游戏，扩建木筏，解锁科技很有成就感，但是游戏糟糕的后期体验毁了这一点。
游戏中期开始，主线岛屿全都是跑酷解密，而且玩家前中期急需、后期毫无用处的科技全是后期解锁。前期需要这些死活不给，快通关了再给有啥用啊？而且后期解谜一个比一个恶心，完全没有生存探索的要素了，没劲。
勉强给个好评，游戏要是能优化科技获得的时间点就好了，可惜没得。只能自己打mod搞了
